name: Karnavati Finance Limited
about: Karnavati Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the provision of various financial services. The company offers personal, business, auto, education, and mortgage/property-backed loans, as well as home, refinance, construction, investment property, vehicle, and other loans. It also provides secured and unsecured term, business and working capital, short-term and long-term, SME, and asset-backed financing, as well as credit facilities. The company was formerly known as Karnavati Finance and Leasing Limited and changed its name to Karnavati Finance Limited in December 1989. Karnavati Finance Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Jamnagar, India.
